scenes.prose_inline: Hunter stepped out of the family estate and boarded the shuttle bound for the Coruscant spaceport. Halfway there, a loose bolt glanced his forearm — a shallow cut, nothing more. By the time the shuttle docked he still had the datapad his father had pressed into his hand on the landing pad.
Ben learned of the hidden Jacen parallel in the archive: Revelation R01 settled over him. He noticed Desh watching. Nothing physical changed.
